discovery_notes: Cell B287, follow-up 2 of B022 (DS 2017). 30 standard searches, snippets only. New: D23 Expo 2017 Disney Store sets (Designer Collection, Art of Snow White, Star Wars Trooper, Pixar Framed, PWP pins), DSSH Oscar Winner five, stained-glass Dr. Facilier/Yzma, Dark Tales #1, June patriotic four, August Lion King three, September Walk in the Park and Bookmark pins, Hercules 20th surprise. PTD flip per-pin edition sizes recorded on 436 keys but holds kept for maintainer. Sources only referenced in not_found leads are listed for traceability.
